source: public Unegui listing pages via web search/open
notes: Observed root page filters for all 15 existing Darkhanzar categories and 60 useful child variants. 830 taxonomy nodes have not each been inspected.

Native select controls are shown as [Select] by public text extraction; labels are verified but exhaustive select option lists are not exposed. Empty options must not be claimed as a complete Unegui enum.
Keys are normalized Darkhanzar implementation keys, not private Unegui IDs.
Brands/models/rooms/carriers are often category tree levels rather than extra attributes. Reuse existing taxonomy.
Imported snapshots lack many attributes. Missing must remain unknown; never infer elevator/lease/condition from absence. Active attribute filter should match only explicit known values.
Do not replace unknown numeric values with zero. Derive year/importYear only from explicit title pair, mileage/engine/transmission/fuel only from explicit source features.
Keep source and observed timestamp for generated metadata.

For verified kids, pets, food and many service branches, the source exposes only common location/price controls; absence of custom branch fields here is observed, not an assumption of age/size/breed fields.
